notes: Sale-order date_start/date_end are DERIVED (not native sale.order fields): computed as min(project.date_start) and max(project.date) across the member project.project records that reference each order, per the task's Step 3 methodology.

pf_actual_revenue (act_rev) does not always equal the sum of posted invoice amounts (amount_untaxed) tied to the same sale order. This is structurally expected when a sale order/commercial parent groups multiple project.project records sharing one order: invoices are recorded at the order level while pf_actual_revenue is tracked per project. Observed discrepancies: group 'DD10105 - Arky - Gestione cantiere con Odoo' (act_rev sum = 98100 vs. posted-invoice sum = 86100) and group 'DD10006 - Secco Sistemi S.p.A. - Assistenza post go-live' (act_rev = 28500 vs. posted-invoice sum = 19000). Both are reported as-is without reconciliation.

planning.slot future data (Step 5) was NOT deduplicated per explicit instruction. Several exact duplicate slot pairs (same resource, date/time, hours) were found and summed as-is for projects 497 (DD100TBD - Secco - Crescita), 740 (DD10241 - Penta Formazione - Affiancamento alla crescita) and 759 (DD10194 - Soul - Odoo).

SharePoint/Teams search (Step 9) found NO documents with 'SAL' / 'avanzamento' / 'stato lavori' in the filename for any of the 6 distinct clients in scope (Secco Sistemi S.p.A., Soul Srl, Arky Srl, IMO SRL, Penta Formazione S.r.l., Wow Solution S.r.l.), despite checking each client's dedicated Team site/folder (TeamSoul, 'Canale Generale Arky', 'Canale Generale IMO Digiduu') where such sites exist, plus generic keyword and folderName-filtered searches. No dedicated Team site was found at all for Penta Formazione S.r.l. Closest related (but non-matching-name) documents found: 'ARKY - Consuntivo Aprile 2026.xlsx' and 'Status fatture.xlsx' in the Arky/Consuntivi SharePoint folder — these were NOT counted as sal_docs since their filenames do not match the required SAL/avanzamento/stato-lavori pattern. All sal_docs lists are therefore empty (real 'not found' result, not an omission).

Two projects in scope are archived/inactive Odoo records (active=False), retrievable only by explicitly widening the domain to include inactive records: id 321 'CC20795 DG2 - Secco Sistemi - Prototipazione CRM Odoo' and id 447 'DD10030 - Secco Sistemi -Affiancamento Helpdesk'. Their groups are flagged active=false accordingly (single-member groups, so group-level active mirrors the one member).

Project 447 ('DD10030 - Secco Sistemi -Affiancamento Helpdesk') has date_start/date (Odoo 'Data di scadenza') both unset (false) on the project record itself, so the corresponding group's date_start/date_end and its sale order's derived date_start/date_end are all null, even though the linked order (DD10030) has three posted, fully paid invoices.

Name-collision caution: 'DD100TBD - Secco - Crescita' (project 497, standalone, no linked sale order) and 'DD10100 - Secco - Crescita' (group of projects 801+802, linked to sale order DD10100) are two DISTINCT groups for the same client (Secco Sistemi S.p.A.) with near-identical names — do not conflate them in the report.
Project 671 ('DD10105 - Arky - Assistenza ') carries a trailing space in its Odoo project name; reproduced verbatim (unedited) in the 'members' list per the zero-fabrication rule.
Tag name sort uses plain ASCII/Python string ordering (uppercase before lowercase), matching the convention observed in the reference groups.json (e.g. 'consulenza' sorts after all capitalized tags).

Two groups tie for prop_price = 92100.00 ('DD10105 - Arky - Gestione cantiere con Odoo' and 'DD101XX - Arky - Affiancamento alla crescita'); their relative order in the sorted output is not semantically meaningful beyond the tie.

notes: Project IDs 421, 598 and 756 are inactive (active=false) in Odoo and were only retrievable by explicitly bypassing the default active_test filter (domain with an explicit '|', ['active','=',true], ['active','=',false] clause); the initial plain ['id','in',[...]] search silently returned only the 4 active projects (499, 589, 590, 834).

Parent-project grouping via x_studio_progetto_padre merged 4 of the 7 projects (499, 589, 590, 598) under the commercial parent 'DD10025 - Union Plus - Implementazione Odoo', since their analytic accounts (541, 755, 636, 644) all share that value. Project 834's account has x_studio_progetto_padre=false (standalone), and project 421 has no account_id at all (standalone).

Baseline dedup for the Union Plus group: order_id 2547 (sale order 'DD10025') is referenced by 3 members (499, 589, 590). Per the stated rule, only the first occurrence (project 499, taken in ascending project-id order) counts toward prop_days/prop_price; members 'DD10025 - UnionPlus - Fase3' (589) and 'DD10025 - UnionPlus - Hypercare' (590) are excluded from that sum (baseline_excluded) to avoid triple-counting the same commercial proposal. Project 598 (order 2804, 'DD10156') is a distinct order and is counted individually, adding its own pf_proposal_days=0 / pf_proposal_price=6000.

Members with a null order_id (projects 421 and 756, both standalone groups) always count individually toward the baseline sum per the explicit instruction for this task, and are never placed in baseline_excluded (both have pf_proposal_days=pf_proposal_price=0 regardless).

Sale-order date_start/date_end are DERIVED, not native sale.order fields: for each order_id, date_start = min(date_start) and date_end = max(date) across the project.project records that reference that order via sale_order_id or reinvoiced_sale_order_id. This approximates the order's active period and may not exactly match the order's own commercial start/end dates.

Planning residuo (planning.slot, step 5): a domain search for project_id in [421,499,589,590,598,756,834] AND start_datetime >= '2026-08-27 00:00:00' returned ZERO records. A follow-up unfiltered search on the same 7 projects (ordered by start_datetime desc) confirmed the most recent slot for any of them starts 2026-05-18 (project 590, 'DD10025 - UnionPlus - Hypercare', ends 2026-05-29) — i.e. there is genuinely no planning residuo beyond the cutoff date for this PL's projects, not a query error. All groups therefore have planning_future = {months: [], by_resource: [], total_days: 0, slot_count: 0}.

SAL/avanzamento-lavori search (Union Plus): sharepoint_folder_search('Union Plus') located the client's main project folder 'Progetti Union Plus' (site UnionPlus). Its full top-level listing (read_resource) and the 'Documenti Da Cliente' subfolder listing were checked directly — no file or subfolder with SAL/avanzamento/stato-lavori in the name was found. A dedicated folder search for 'Avanzamento' across the tenant found such folders only for other clients (Mondeo1, Mastrotto, YuppyperRecover) — none for UnionPlus. The secondary sharepoint_search(folderName='Union Plus') check (known to be fuzzy/unreliable) returned only unrelated generic timesheet/registro-ore spreadsheets, confirming no genuine SAL doc surfaced either way.

SAL/avanzamento-lavori search (Adami Teloni): sharepoint_folder_search('Adami Teloni') surfaced only legacy/unrelated material — an old CreditSafe credit-report folder and pre-2020/2023 OneNote notebook folders on a separate 'AdamiTeloniS.r.l' site — with no dedicated Digiduu project folder and nothing resembling a SAL/avanzamento document. The secondary sharepoint_search(folderName='Adami Teloni') check likewise returned only unrelated generic spreadsheets/transcripts.
